questions.q: According to the passage, when is a grievance cheapest to resolve?
questions.x: Answer: 'When it is heard early'. The opening sentence says early resolution is cheaper. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: A grievance that is heard early is cheaper to resolve than one that reaches a court. In many workplaces, small complaints about shifts, overtime or leave fester because there is no simple channel to raise them. Over months, they turn into distrust and sometimes into strikes. A committee that meets regularly, records complaints and replies within a fixed time can prevent much of this damage at little cost.

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹35,000, closing inventory is ₹95,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹6,50,000. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (35,000 + 95,000) / 2 = ₹65,000.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 6,50,000 / 65,000 = 10 times.

questions.q: A partner's capital on 1 April was ₹1,30,000. The partner introduced additional capital of ₹50,000 on 1 January (financial year ends 31 March). Interest on capital is allowed at 6% p.a. The interest for the year is:
questions.x:
Interest on opening capital = 1,30,000 × 6% = ₹7,800.
Additional capital earns interest for 3 months = 50,000 × 6% × 3/12 = ₹750.
Total = ₹8,550.

questions.q: A firm has Cash ₹45,000, Debtors ₹90,000, Inventory ₹85,000, Prepaid expenses ₹7,500, Creditors ₹70,000, Bills payable ₹7,500 and Outstanding expenses ₹5,000. Its current ratio is:

o: As decided by the senior partner
In the ratio of time devoted
questions.x: Section 13 of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 provides equal sharing.

questions.q: The cash book of a firm shows a debit (bank) balance of ₹10,000. Cheques issued but not yet presented: ₹2,000; cheques deposited but not yet credited: ₹3,000. The balance as per the pass book is:
questions.x:
Start with cash book balance ₹10,000.
+ Cheques issued not presented (bank has not yet paid) 2,000
− Cheques deposited not credited 3,000
Pass book balance = ₹9,000.

questions.q: A machine is purchased for ₹3,50,000. Its estimated useful life is 8 years with a residual value of ₹2,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (3,50,000 − 2,000) / 8 = 3,48,000 / 8 = ₹43,500 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: From the following, compute Gross Profit: Opening stock ₹55,000; Purchases ₹1,70,000; Sales ₹2,55,000; Closing stock ₹15,000.
questions.x:
Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases − Closing stock
= 55,000 + 1,70,000 − 15,000 = ₹2,10,000.
Gross profit = Net sales − COGS = 2,55,000 − 2,10,000 = ₹45,000.
Carriage inwards is a direct expense (Trading A/c).

Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

Annual bonus = 8,000 × 12 × 8.33% = ₹7,997. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: ₹36,000 is divided among three branches in the ratio 7 : 5 : 3. The largest share is:
questions.x:
Sum of ratio terms = 7 + 5 + 3 = 15.
One part = 36,000 / 15 = ₹2,400.

questions.q: If 6 May of a certain year falls on a Monday, on which day of the week will 22 December of the same year fall?
questions.x:
Days from 6 May to 22 December = 230 = 32 weeks + 6 odd days.
Monday + 6 = Sunday. (February is not involved, so leap years do not matter.)

questions.q: The average weight of 19 parcels is 41 kg. When one more parcel is added, the average becomes 43 kg. The weight of the new parcel is:
questions.x:
Old total = 19 × 41 = 779 kg. New total = 20 × 43 = 860 kg.
New parcel = 860 − 779 = 81 kg.
Shortcut: new value = new average + (increase × old count) = 43 + 2 × 19 = 81 kg.

questions.q: Find the odd one out among 35, 127, 37 and 173.
questions.x: 37, 127, 173 are all prime numbers; 35 is not. Hence 35 is the odd one out.

questions.q: A number when divided by 48 leaves a remainder of 20. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 6?
questions.x: N = 48k + 20. Since 6 divides 48, the remainder is simply 20 mod 6 = 2.

questions.q: Three sirens sound at intervals of 6, 20, 8 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(6, 20, 8) seconds.

questions.q: The marks of students are: 93, 94, 38, 95, 87, 43, 35. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 485; number of values = 7. Mean = 485/7 = 69.29.

questions.q: In what ratio must pulses costing ₹70 per kg be mixed with pulses costing ₹190 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹92 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (190 − 92) : (92 − 70) = 98 : 22 = 49 : 11.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 26, 30, 36, 44, 54, ?
questions.x: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10 — increasing by 2. Next difference = 12, so next term = 54 + 12 = 66.

questions.q: A sum of money lent at simple interest amounts to ₹16,500 in 2 years and to ₹19,500 in 6 years. The rate of interest per annum is:
What is the unit digit of 7^30?
questions.x:
Unit digit depends only on 7. Powers of 7 repeat with cycle 4: 7, 9, 3, 1.
30 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 2 → use position 2 of the cycle → 9.

questions.q:
Members enrolled in a district (thousand) over five years — 2019: 290  |  2020: 340  |  2021: 355  |  2022: 380  |  2023: 360.
What is the average per year over the five years?
What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 12:40?
questions.x:
Angle = |30H − 5.5M| = |30×0 − 5.5×40| = |0 − 220| = 220°.
Since this exceeds 180°, the smaller angle = 360 − 220 = 140°.
(The minute hand gains 5.5° per minute over the hour hand.)

questions.q: Arjun starts from point O and walks 10 km towards South, then turns left and walks 23 km, then turns right and walks 2 km, and finally turns right and walks 39 km. How far is the person from O and in which direction?
questions.x:
Take O as origin, North/East positive.
North–South: -10 -2 = -12 km → 12 km South.
East–West: +23 -39 = -16 km → 16 km West.
Distance = √(16² + 12²) = 20 km, towards South-West.
